review_basis: All nine current GitHub Actions Chromium screenshots were read at player height together with runtime authored-support evidence. No approval is inferred from successful CI or image availability.

frame_reviews.finding: The corrected down-facing camera makes the roof and terminal visible, a real improvement over the sky-only batch. However, this is still a flat obstacle-course vista of black parapet blocks, brown box buildings, orange lines/slabs, teal plates and a thin pale ridge. The player cannot read a lower harbour world or credible industrial construction.

The east look is choked by a giant near-black rectangular block and a wide black canopy. The sign/terminal has scale, but it remains an assemblage of boxes and thin orange bars rather than a readable exterior destination.

The wider west view exposes the problem rather than solving it: teal panels still appear detached/floating above a wall, the route is orange outlines over black stacked rectangles, and surrounding brown facades are too monolithic and repetitive.
Player has genuine Dispatch contact only. The image does not show a Switch House arrival, so it cannot score that region.
Still a Dispatch-side approach rather than a Transfer Beacon frame; it repeats the same black/orange/brown composition.
Runtime support proves Intake Steps, not East Span. The close stair read is a stack of dark slabs with orange noses and does not resemble a credible maintenance stair.
Player is airborne without authored support. The image shows a blocked, generic dark stair/rail composition and is invalid transfer evidence.

This is a real Switch House surface contact, not Boiler Court. The close terminal shot has some destination framing but remains made from raw black rectangular modules, blue panels and an oversized sign.
A Switch House look with readable supported posts, but it has no Boiler Court world and its simple planar panels/black roof read as a prototype scene.

role_reviews.finding: Camera calibration succeeds—recorded direction is a sensible Y≈-0.18—but the visual direction does not. Brown, near-black and orange now form a drab blockout palette rather than a controlled industrial hierarchy.
role_reviews.required_action: Use light/mid/dark material values deliberately; reserve rust/amber for small safety points; establish a memorable open harbour/rail silhouette behind the terminal.

role_reviews.finding: The player can now see the first roof surface but the primary route is visually a series of dark barriers with orange bars. The capture still does not reach the Switch House during its intended phase, then falls during the branch attempt.
role_reviews.required_action: Make the yard-to-intake connection overlapping/forgiving; capture explicit landed support surfaces; stage the east branch after a real switch-house arrival.

role_reviews.finding: Player frames show textures but not construction. The most visible buildings are huge single stained wall faces, all facades use nearly the same treatment, and detached teal plates look like procedural window cards.
role_reviews.required_action: Split broad facades into structural bays/recesses/service bands and add actual side-face windows/pilasters; present low rail/harbour/industrial masses through open sight-lines instead of a token distant ridge.

role_reviews.finding: The newer probe is materially more truthful: it records grounded authored support and camera direction. Browser startup 404s and the PCF warning are gone; only Three.Clock deprecation and expected screenshot ReadPixels stalls remain. Route surface sequencing still needs a collision-level test/adjustment.
role_reviews.required_action: Replace deprecated Clock use, avoid treating ReadPixels capture cost as gameplay performance, and add a geometry/contact test for the initial deck overlap plus east landing.

role_reviews.finding: Current ‘stairs’ are black horizontal slabs with repeated orange noses, while the intended dash transfer captures airborne/failing. Movement purpose and landing surface are not cleanly read.
role_reviews.required_action: Connect deck elevations with shallow supported risers, give the dash line a wide evident landing, and show physical boiler-court entry steps rather than requiring an opaque high jump.

role_reviews.finding: The player-height direction is corrected without transform cheating. However, the initial forward line falls/resets before the automated arrival, and the tiny device still floats disembodied in lower-right frames.
role_reviews.required_action: Overlap the entry deck, use surface-specific navigation guards, and hide/reveal the pulse device only for a firing response rather than persistently presenting a floating block.

role_reviews.finding: A player can identify ‘Kinetic Permit’, but the start view still promises black barriers and orange platforming instead of a real place or an exciting line. No destination beyond the terminal or surrounding lower city is enticing.
role_reviews.required_action: Create one open first-look composition with visible lower rail/harbour, a distant industrial landmark, a clear traversable threshold and recognizable adjacent roof functions.

role_reviews.finding: This is an improvement in camera correctness only. It remains too visibly made of boxes: brown boxes, black boxes, teal cards and orange strips. The batch contains six navigation misses, so it remains invalid as a whole-route proof.
role_reviews.required_action: Reject. Rebuild Dispatch structural articulation and real world layers; fix first deck/contact and east/boiler support flow; recapture every affected player view.

critical_defects.title: Camera is fixed but Dispatch still reads as an empty blockout corridor
critical_defects.fix: Replace monolithic facade/black barrier silhouette with open threshold gaps, lighter structural members, constructed bays and player-visible lower/distant world layers.

critical_defects.title: Floating window-card and repetitive orange-nosing language is visibly placeholder art
critical_defects.fix: Embed windows into both visible facade orientations with recesses/pilasters, and reduce safety colour to narrow mounted nosings rather than route-defining strips/slabs.

critical_defects.title: Initial route contact is not robust enough for a real continuous capture
critical_defects.fix: Overlap/lower the intake deck within bounded step height, validate it with a collision unit test, then record Switch House support before branch input.

critical_defects.title: East-to-Boiler vertical transfer is not demonstrated as landable
critical_defects.fix: Add supported physical entry risers from East landing into Boiler Court, and require actual `dash-viaduct-landing` / `boiler-court` support IDs before those captures.

approval_rule: Run 33963545789 is CAPTURED and INSPECTED. It is not APPROVED. Scores apply only to the three frames whose runtime support matches their requested Dispatch region; navigation-miss frames retain null scores and may not be presented as later-region reviews.
